g.text: Qwen3-32B · frozen pooled polarity-balanced axis · separate relational development collection

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: All four layers and seven positions; original axis sign and extraction threshold retained. Relational development gate passed (800 assigned trials).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Development only. n = complete scored raw index-worlds (all four cells) / 20 assigned per family and kind; these are not semantic-deduplicated independent counts.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Hatching marks unavailable metrics. No axis = no available frozen extraction axis; this does not imply zero target activations. World availability may vary by position.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Record context is identical across question kinds; early cross-kind readouts are not independent replications. Rank transfer and fixed-threshold transfer measure different behavior.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Think-end and answer-boundary states condition on generated reasoning and answer policy. No favorable-site selection, causal-mechanism claim, or subjective-experience claim.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: AUC and accuracy are descriptive point estimates without plotted intervals. The full CSV retains original descriptive gap intervals, not confirmatory confidence claims.
